meta_data.base_class: create a controllable character profile within a given <specific game name> game - these games all support player creation, class selection, and level progression systems.

tool_template.name: create_<class>_profile
tool_template.description: Create a new profile in game <class> with character name, class, and starting level.

player_name.description: The desired name of the player in <class>.

_class.description: The character class (or profession) for the player in <class>.

starting_level.description: The starting level for the player in <class>.

race.description: The race or species of the character in <class>, which may affect the character's abilities or attributes.

difficulty_level.description: The difficulty level setting for the game in <class>, which can range from easy to challenging modes.

game_region.description: The in-game region where the player wishes to start in <class>.

appearance_customization.description: Whether to enable detailed appearance customization for the character in <class>, allowing for latter unique visual personalization.
